messages:
sam-cs: FYI @channel — AcmeHealth (Dedicated) reporting sudden 500s and tail latency spike since ~09:12 UTC. They've hit ~85% of their SLA error budget. Created INC-ACME-789. Need engineering commitment for hotfix or rollback. Can @alex own triage? Can @jamal look at routing/model variants? Details below.
eng-oncall-bot: Incident INC-ACME-789 created: https://incidents/internal/INC-ACME-789 — priority: P1, affected: dedicated/gpu-pool-12.
alex: On it — pulling logs and metrics now. Will check recent deploys and model routing.
jamal: I'm seeing a big error rate coming from requests hitting model-variant 'gpt-q-v1' on pool gpu-p12. Errors look like repeated KV cache resize failures, OOM-ish. Spike aligns with 03:07 deploy yesterday.
sophia: We rolled runtime patch runtime/heap-fix yesterday at 03:05 UTC limited to dedicated pools. Possible regression. If rollback, need approval to revert runtime change. Also suggest canary divert first.
sam-cs: Customer asks for ETA within 2 hours. They offered to accept temporary routing to fallback model if that prevents outages.
alex: Plan proposal: 1) Divert 30% of Acme traffic to model-variant 'gpt-q-v0' immediately as mitigation (jamal). 2) Rollback runtime patch to runtime/2026-03-15-heapfix-prev (sophia) in the affected pool if mitigation doesn't reduce errors within 20m. 3) Run smoke tests + wave traffic back. I can execute rollback and own deployment.
maria: I'll prioritize an expedited code review for the rollback scripts and approve once tested. Ping me when ready.
jamal: Starting routing tweak now. Using route policy 'customer:acmehealth' weight change -> gpt-q-v1:70, gpt-q-v0:30. ETA ~5m. Will monitor error rate.
eng-oncall-bot: Deploy job queued: job-4823 (routing-change).
alex: Starting rollback prep. Runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/rollback-runtime — procedure: checkout, set runtime image to runtime/2026-03-15-heapfix-prev, restart runtime-manager, run smoke tests. Command snippet:
```
# rollback snippet
kubectl -n cluster-dedicated set image deploy/runtime runtime=registry.redwood/runtime:2026-03-15-heapfix-prev
kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime -n cluster-dedicated --timeout=5m
./scripts/smoke_tests.sh --customer acmehealth
```
I'll start the rollback if error rate doesn't drop to <1% in 20m.
sam-cs: Customer prefers rollback if mitigation fails. Please update here with timestamps for each step so CS can inform Acme.
alex: Routing change applied. job-4823 succeeded. Monitoring now — initial error rate dropped from 12% -> 6% but still high. Continuing observation for next 8m.
jamal: Confirmed metrics in dashboards: 5xx rate trending down but tail latency still elevated. Preparing the canary for runtime rollback (5% traffic) to validate before full rollback.
sophia: Canary ready. If canary passes smoke tests I'll trigger full rollback. Need one maint window slot since this touches runtime-manager. Time estimate: canary deploy 10m, smoke tests 5m, full rollback 20m.
maria: Code review done for rollback scripts. LGTM, will merge and trigger handoff.
eng-oncall-bot: Canary deploy job queued: job-4830.
alex: Starting canary deploy now (job-4830). I'll post results in ~12m.
sam-cs: Thanks — CS will tell Acme we'll attempt mitigation now and will escalate to rollback if canary fails. Customer requested 30-min update cadence.
alex: Canary smoke tests: PASS. 0 failing requests in 200 samples, latency back to baseline. Proceeding to full rollback to runtime/2026-03-15-heapfix-prev across pool gpu-p12. Estimated completion 25m. I'll post live logs.
jamal: I'll keep 20% of traffic on fallback during full rollback to avoid overload.
eng-oncall-bot: Full rollback job started: job-4831.
alex: Rollback completed. Post-rollback checks: 5xx rate <0.5%, p95 latency within SLO. Monitoring 10m for stability. Rolling back routing weights to original gradually.
sam-cs: Notifying Acme: we've rolled back runtime and are monitoring. They've requested incident RCA and timeline. Can engineering commit to a follow-up RCA and mitigation plan by EOD?
sophia: Yes — committing to 1) RCA draft by EOD, 2) test improvements for cache size tolerance within 48h, 3) a patch with guardrails (QA + canary automation) in 72h.
maria: I'll help with the release playbook updates and automate the rollback runbook steps.
jamal: I'll prepare routing policy rollback automation so short-term mitigations can be applied faster.
sam-cs: Great — CS will coordinate postmortem and share with customer. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
